# Análise rápida

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import plotnine as p9
from relatorio_demo.funcoes import resumo

df = pd.DataFrame({'x': range(20), 'y': [i**1.6 for i in range(20)]})
print(resumo(df, 'y'))

(p9.ggplot(df, p9.aes('x','y')) + p9.geom_line() + p9.geom_point() + p9.theme_minimal())
```
